description: Ten Katestraat 5-21 (BAG 1937; a later flat-roofed renewal row): red-brown brick, three plain white windows per storey on 6.1 m, a top storey of two small square lights under a plain parapet with a light coping, house doors paired under one transom

match.note: the flat roof and the 15 m parapet carry it; BAG's 1937 is kept as the year range's floor

parapet.note: plain parapet with a light coping, nothing over it

rhythm.groundFloor: paired house doors or a shop

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2018-07-29: identical flat fronts, 3 windows per storey, two small attic lights

schemaLimits: the paired doors under one transom are drawn as one door
